Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

bring back verb

also lead back, take back (a person), escort home, reduce to, bring to (a state)

classical

Cic. Att. 4.6.2: redūcī in carcerem (Lewis & Short)
Quint. 12.8.3: bene comitātī per forum redūcuntur (Lewis & Short)

redūcō, redūcere, redūxī, reductum

verb, third conjugation

lead back, bring back; escort home

Other words

  • redigō, redigere, redēgī, redāctum — drive back, bring back; bring or reduce (to a state); collect (money)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Caes. BC 1.76: rem ad prīstinam bellī ratiōnem redēgit (Lewis & Short); Liv. 21.9 (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • bene comitātī per forum redūcuntur

    they are escorted home through the forum by a good crowdQuint. 12.8.3 (Lewis & Short)

  • rem ad prīstinam bellī ratiōnem redēgit

    he brought the campaign back to the old way of fightingCaes. BC 1.76 (Lewis & Short)

See also return, bring.

SourcesLewis & Short: reduco · Lewis & Short: redigo
